rows.name: segments
rows.description: The number of items the timer should display. Suggest max segments is 5.

rows.name: onSegmentChange
rows.type: Fires when the segment moves automatically. Pass null to disable automatic movement. | null

rows.name: onSegmentComplete
rows.description: Fires when a progress animation is finished.

rows.name: activeIndex
rows.description: The index of the active segment, zero-based.

rows.name: delay
rows.description: The time between each segment, in milliseconds.

rows.name: changeDelay
rows.description: The time after one segment is complete and the next one starts, in milliseconds.

rows.name: enableAssistiveMessage
rows.description: Enable the existence of assistiveMessage for screen readers

rows.name: assistiveMessage
rows.description: Useful for customizing or translating the message for screen readers.
rows.type: ((delay: number, activeIndex: number, total?: number) => string)
rows.default: ( delay: number, activeIndex: number, total: number ) => { return `current segment ${activeIndex} of ${total}, ${ delay / 1000 } seconds until next slide`; }
